title: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: Queen's timeless masterpiece in its true, original key of Bb major. Features the unforgettable vocal ballad melody everyone loves.
generalTip: Key of Bb major (Bb and Eb). Sing the words in your head as you play to capture Freddie Mercury's phrasing.

sections.label: "Mama, just killed a man"
tips: 👑 The world's most famous rock ballad opening: "Mama, just killed a man"
👆 Start on F with Finger 2, step up to G (Finger 3) on "just", then down to Eb and D
🎵 "Put a gun against his head": rapid repeated G notes stepping down through F and Eb

sections.label: "Life had just begun"
tips: 👆 Finger 2 on F, Finger 1 on D for "life had" — then leap to Bb (Finger 4) on "just begun"
🎵 "Now I've gone and thrown it all away": four steady Bb notes stepping down to A then climbing to high C
✨ Hold the long high C note for the full 4 beats

sections.label: "Mama, ooh..."
tips: 💧 Start on Eb (black key) for "Ma-ma" — tender and emotional
🖤 ^F is F# leading into G: the famous weeping "ooh" phrase
🎤 "Didn't mean to make you cry": step down smoothly from G to F to Eb to D, landing on C
